1011001.desc: It may be a simple cleaning job, but I'll still give it 200% of my energy!
1011001.name: Limitless Energy!

1011701.desc: Warm, long-sleeved pajamas, with asymmetric stockings for a touch of cuteness. The bunny is about to hop off to the world of sweet dreams.
1011701.name: Bunny Sleepwear

1020501.desc: A deeply clear blue that radiates gentle grace. There's an oceanic depth concealed in her service-oriented attitude and quiet smile.
1020501.name: Azure Heart

1051701.desc: A fresh, practical ensemble perfect for everyday life. One look at her and you can tell – she's ready to have a great day out with you.
1051701.name: Daily Steps

1070301.desc: Cute and energetic. She carries behind her a backpack full of sweet little secrets, sealing them away with an innocent giggle upon the wind.
1070301.name: Canvas Day

1990301.desc: Her red ribbon tie bounces with each step. Her youthful heart is filled with anticipation – for the relaxing day she is about to spend with you~♪
1990301.name: Rendezvous Between Classes

2012101.desc: A breezy, sleeveless top adorned with purple-and-white stripes. Aim for pillow fight supremacy with lithe and limber moves!
2012101.name: Operation: Pillow Fight

2021201.desc: Folded into her uniform is the gentle scent of books. Even with her long hair neatly tied up, her reassuringly elegant smile remains unchanged.
2021201.name: One Afternoon's Page

2060301.desc: Like a pure, bright star plucked from the night sky, every little detail glimmers with the light of hope.
2060301.name: Dreamy Starlight

2990301.desc: She carries with her the sweet aroma and the electrifying freshness of the sea breeze. Whose heart has she stricken with her cuteness today?
2990301.name: Seaspray Leisure

3031101.desc: A pure-white long-sleeved shirt that echoes the pristine impressions of the first snow of the year. From simplicity, leisurely elegance flows.
3031101.name: Bedside Bared Hearts

3031201.desc: Tea isn't the only thing I'm serving you – there's also my sweet care and the courtesy hidden in my smile.
3031201.name: Lovingly Sweet Tea Time

3040701.desc: A golden-yellow fledgling basking beneath the soft sunlight. It warbles a fairytale melody of sweet candy and seashells.
3040701.name: Fledgling's Fairytale

3120101.desc: Beneath the neatly tucked collar of her sailor uniform is a sly, mischievous smile, her black skirt fluttering like the playful waves at night. Beware, for this "mysterious merchant" has opened up shop at school.
3120101.name: Night of the Empty Bell

4030301.desc: She calls it "special hospitality" with a touch of playful elegance. What heart-throbbing amusement is she planning?
4030301.name: Lazy Service

4990201.desc: Majesty and grace join in perfect unison, fulfilling the supreme contract known as service with an elegant demeanor.
4990201.name: Elegant Affection

4990601.desc: Equipped with an eye mask, she soars to the realm of dreams, embraced by the moon and clouds. May this gentle, restful world be embraced with the sweetest colors.
4990601.name: Cloudtop Reverie

5010701.desc: Black-and-white panda pajamas. Soft, round, and irresistibly pokeable.
5010701.name: Panda Dango

5010801.desc: Her tied-up hair bobs with each light, airy step she takes. With her at your side, even the walk back home becomes breezy and light.
5010801.name: A Cozy Walk Home

5020101.desc: A white camisole coupled with a light beige coat. As elegant as a camellia beneath the moonlight, even the night seems warmer in her presence.
5020101.name: Fragrant Tea Beneath the Moonlight

5060101.desc: Step away from the chessboard for a moment and pick up the teapot. As the steam rises around you both, she delivers a warm kind of wisdom that sees through the human heart.
5060101.name: Planning Comes Later

9010701.desc: A bowtie hangs casually from her loosened collar. A hint of danger, a passion that cannot be contained – a perfect cocktail that makes your heart race.
9010701.name: Heart-Pounding Bell's Chime

96000101.desc: Her neat, stylish uniform exudes both seriousness and elegance. Even the simple act of stepping through the school gates seems to carry an air of ceremony.
96000101.name: Prologue to School

99000101.desc: Fully geared up and ready to go! Let's see what kind of pranks she'll pull on her way to school today!
99000101.name: Cheerful Route to School

99000102.desc: Her school uniform is a perfect fit. Even when dressed as an honor student, she can't hide the little devil on her shoulder.
99000102.name: Honor Student's Demeanor

99000201.desc: Pure and straightforward, she explores her surroundings with uncertainty, feeling everything with her hands.
99000201.name: Time of Innocence

99000202.desc: A neat and tidy dress. Her focused gaze quietly observes the world.
99000202.name: Inexperienced Observer

99000301.desc: This singularly white outfit is wholly untarnished. It's almost like an extension of her quiet personality.
99000301.name: Pure White Whisper

99000302.desc: A formal outfit complemented by a jumper skirt. It glows with shy, adorable charm.
99000302.name: Serene Dress
